This violates Checklist 2: 'For each event the task requires unconditionally... does a hard clause make it happen'. The missing goal prevents state-based completion tracking for the primary objective.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) captures the goal 'reach exit'; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures the rule 'pick up immediately after fall'; Response(at_exit, holding_box) enforces having the box at the exit to satisfy 'If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands', preventing reaching the goal with dropped hands. All clauses are hard as required by the task wording.
